mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a month indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, driving up interest rates and negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 shows sustained growth over two quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity and potential supply chain pressures, which can lead to increased inflation expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals high inflation and tight monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts by more than 5% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which can lead to a broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST decreases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP increases and retail and food services sales decrease simultaneously over a quarter, it signals a shift in consumer spending patterns, which can lead to a mixed economic signal and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and RSAFS decreases over 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when both conditions are met.
